candidates.title: Spain housing crisis: Thousands seek tenant protections after eviction of 87-year-old
candidates.excerpt: In Madrid, a massive protest unfolded as tens of thousands rallied for stronger tenant protections amidst escalating rents and evictions. The poignant eviction of an elderly woman has spotlighted Spain’s ongoing housing crisis, sparking demands for measures to prevent fraud and a moratorium on evictions without alternative housing. With a notable shortage in rental properties, the housing dilemma continues to intensify despite recent economic growth.

candidates.title: PM Modi recalls 2016 surgical strikes, says terrorism will get decisive response
candidates.excerpt: During his radio address, Mann Ki Baat, Prime Minister Narendra Modi discussed key national issues, including the 2016 surgical strikes against terrorism, reaffirming India's strong stance and zero-tolerance policy toward cross-border threats. He called on citizens to contribute to the Census, emphasized cleanliness efforts linked to Mahatma Gandhi, and expressed support for the youth's battle against narcotics.
